Definition: a section (half) of a shekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin)
BiblicalUsage: 1) half, part also called "shekel of the sanctuary" or "holy shekel"; 2) half a shekel (meton) There appears to be at least three different shekels, one of silver, gold and copper. See a Bible Dictionary for a complete treatment of the subject.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
